method: Catalog of documented experiment families plus all discoverable recognized result-file paths in local worktrees. Missing data remain null/not recorded. Historical notes are not relabeled as exact-hash modern tests.
units_note: Mb/s are decimal bits/second; original notes sometimes label MB/GB loosely. Values converted from exact byte/time notes are approximate. Local quota estimates are not Cloud billing telemetry. p95 of a few samples or median of arm p95s is not a population p95.
coverage_limits: An index is not a claim that every scaffolding run has been interpreted or every candidate tried. Some old binaries, configs and per-run cleanup records are absent from summaries.
Failed and incomplete arms stay separate; substrate, API primitive, simulation and full transport results are not pooled.
The 2026-05 archives include external-origin, shared-server and non-hash-verified notes; do not rank them against November local exact-body runs.
Live Google test account credentials and runtime profiles are excluded. Only aggregate fields explicitly whitelisted in the generator are imported.
